svg.text: Non-embodied somatic markers across 827 cognitive cycles (2026-04-24 – 2026-04-26)
Per-cycle valence (positive/negative) and severity (intensity) traced as the affective state available to decision-making.
Mean valence = 0.81 · mean severity = 0.00 · severity non-zero on 0/827 cycles
Affective state is present and varying without a body — somatic-marker shape recovered from non-embodied substrate.
Reference: Damasio (1999) — The Feeling of What Happens
